main_body: Wooden weapon rack base box (rows ~26-46) with three spears standing upright above it; the box has horizontal rails and slatted panels drawn face-on
top_band: Rows 26-29: a light tan/orange band at the top of the box (about 2 rows of light tone at rows 27-28, under a dark outline at row 26), which reads as a rim/cap line rather than a surface. No ellipse or clear horizontal surface is visible from above.
evidence: Down the middle column the spear shafts run to row 25, then the box begins with a dark outline and a thin 2-row light band, followed immediately by a flat banded front face with horizontal rails (rows 30-46). The thin band is a rim, not a top surface, and there is no distinct front-edge line or eave shadow. The compartments are painted flat. The base and the horizontal rails show no top faces, so this is a front elevation with a thin cap.

style.evidence: The outline is a dark brown that leans toward the wood. The wood ramp has about 4 steps (tan highlight, orange, mid brown, dark brown), plus grey-white spear heads and gold ferrules. There is some grain from the horizontal bands and the small notches. The spear shafts are fairly flat, mostly single-tone columns with one highlight. Overall it is slightly thinner than the Beodeul stall and well, which carry more texture dots and more steps per material.
